headline: Holdings Shift on the Exposed Fronts
war_summary: Since the last edition, Weathered Expanse has seen another marked change in the ledger: its nine strategic bases now stand at five Warden, two Colonial and two unheld, against three, three and three previously. Linn’s Mercy remains ten Colonial-held bases and one unheld, but activity has intensified to eight event rows in two hours, the latest near the reporting hour. Mooring County is now wholly Warden-held, with all twelve bases under that banner; the prior edition listed eleven Warden and one Colonial. Marban Hollow keeps its four-Warden, three-Colonial, one-unheld division, though no base events appear in the last six hours. Nevish Line remains six to two, with two event rows in six hours; Stlican Shelf has three. Paired loss and capture rows may record a single transfer, so the tallies are not a simple count of separate battles. Heavy casualty reporting also continues in several theaters, but most regions show no recent strategic-base events. War 140 remains undecided, with 34 victory towns required.
